# ractermx_retention_policy (Resource)

Manages the RacterMX email log retention policy. This is a singleton resource (one per organization).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the email log retention policy.
# This is a singleton resource — only one per organization.
resource "ractermx_retention_policy" "default" {
  metadata_retention_days = 90

  event_specific_retention = {
    "bounced"  = 180
    "rejected" = 30
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata_retention_days` (Number) Number of days to retain email metadata (7-2555).

### Optional

- `event_specific_retention` (Map of Number) Per-event retention overrides. Map of event name to retention days (7-2555).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier. Always 'default' for the singleton retention policy.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the retention policy was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the retention policy using the fixed ID "default".
terraform import ractermx_retention_policy.default default
```
